leadText:
(Japanese: ゆれる島の戦い！ドジョッチVSナマズン！！ Shaking Island Battle! VS !!) was intended to be the 101st episode of , and the 375th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It was set to air in Japan on November 4, 2004, but the episode was skipped due to nearly a week before the first airing of AG100. It has never aired in Japan or in any other country, and is thus not considered canon.

Likely as a result of this episode's cancellation, the move , as well as similar moves such as and , has not been used in the animated series in any later point.

==Trivia==
This was the only Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire episode to be banned in every country, the second episode of the entire to be banned in every country (the first being EP038), and the first regular episode of the entire animated series to never be aired at all. Two later episodes were also cancelled just before airing because of an earthquake.
Because this episode never aired, is never shown learning the location of the final Hoenn League Gym onscreen.
A in this episode seems to be a giant Pokémon, just like Nero.
